title: Pecuniary
summary: PECU'NIARY, adjective [Latin pecuniarius, from pecunia, money, from pecus, cattle.] 1. Relating to money; as pecuniary affairs or losses. 2. Consisting of money; as a pecuniary mulct or penalty.
